title: Define rootfs runtime artifact install manifest
purpose: Create the authoritative rootfs install manifest contract for all runtime artifacts required by Distribution Alpha.
scope: Define required rootfs paths for agentd, policy pack, semantic tool manifest, ModelBroker config, run-state, audit, rollback, memory, and release metadata.
Define owner, mode, persistence, hash, secret-safety, and validation expectations for every artifact.
Map each artifact back to Runtime Foundation proof and future image assembly consumer.
Define a machine-readable manifest format that can be validated before image promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest includes every mandatory artifact from Distribution Alpha entry criteria.
Manifest rejects raw secret values in installed config, memory, audit, and provenance.
Manifest distinguishes boot handoff path from managed runtime binary path.
Manifest can be consumed by later rootfs staging and release provenance tasks.
verification: Confirm semantic tool manifest excludes normal-mode shell.exec.
Confirm ModelBroker config defaults to stub/local-only mode.
Confirm no generated artifacts are committed.
risk_notes: Without a manifest contract, image assembly can silently omit runtime safety artifacts.
implementation_steps: Inventory mandatory runtime artifacts and paths from the Alpha entry criteria.
Define a manifest schema with artifact ID, path, kind, owner, mode, persistence, validation, and source proof.
Document secret-safety and provenance rules for installed config and metadata.
Add handoff notes for TASK-DALPHA-002, TASK-DALPHA-003, TASK-DALPHA-004, and TASK-DALPHA-008.
failure_modes: Manifest only lists agentd and omits policy, tools, ModelBroker config, or runtime state.
Manifest requires remote model credentials for acceptance.
Manifest has no validation fields for later automation.

verification_matrix.expected: All mandatory artifact classes are present

blocked_until: Validation fields are concrete enough for automation.
Manifest maps to later image assembly and provenance tasks.
